entries.title: Joshua 21:1
segments: And the heads of the fathers of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Joshua 21:2
segments: And they spoke to them in Shiloh, in the land of Canaan, saying, the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give cities to us to live in, and their open lands for our cattle.

entries.title: Joshua 21:3
segments: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance these cities and their open lands, at the command of the LORD:

entries.title: Joshua 21:4
segments: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. And the sons of Aaron the priest, of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:5
segments: And the rest of the sons of Kohath [had] by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:6
segments: And the sons of Gershon [had] by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:7
segments: The sons of Merari by their families [had] out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun. twelve cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:8
segments: And the sons of Israel gave by lot to the Levites these cities with their open lands, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

entries.title: Joshua 21:9
segments: And they gave out of the tribe of the sons of Judah, and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, these cities which are called by name,

entries.title: Joshua 21:10
segments: which the sons of Aaron had, [being] of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the sons of Levi, for theirs was the first lot.

entries.title: Joshua 21:11
segments: And they gave them the city of Arba, the father of Anak (it [is] Hebron) in the hills of Judah, with its open lands around it.

entries.title: Joshua 21:12
segments: But the fields of the city of Arba and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his own.

entries.title: Joshua 21:13
segments: And to the sons of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron and its open lands [as] a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Libnah and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:14
segments: and Jattir and its open lands, and Eshtemoa and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:15
segments: and Holon and its open lands, and Debir and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:16
segments: and Ain and its open lands, and Juttah and its open lands, and Beth-shemesh and its open lands, nine cities from these two tribes.

entries.title: Joshua 21:17
segments: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon and its open lands, Geba and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:18
segments: Anathoth and its open lands, and Almon and its open lands; four cities and their open lands.

entries.title: Joshua 21:19
segments: And all the cities of the sons of Aaron the priest [were] thirteen cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:20
segments: And the families of the sons of Kohath, the Levites who were left of the sons of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe Ephraim.

entries.title: Joshua 21:21
segments: And they gave them Shechem and its open lands in mount Ephraim as a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Gezer and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:22
segments: and Kibzaim and its open lands, and Beth-horon and its open lands; four cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:23
segments: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh and open lands, Gibbethon and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:24
segments: Aijalon and its open lands, Gath-rimmon and its open lands; four cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:25
segments: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach and its open lands, and Gath-rimmon and its open lands; two cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:26
segments: All the cities [were] ten, and their open lands, for the families of the sons of Kohath that were left.

entries.title: Joshua 21:27
segments: And to the sons of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, from the half tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and its open lands [as] a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beesh-terah and its open lands; two cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:28
segments: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kishon and its open lands, and Daberath and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:29
segments: Jarmuth and its open lands, En-gannim and its open lands, four cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:30
segments: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal and its open lands, and Abdon and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:31
segments: Helkath and its open lands, and Rehob and its open lands, four cities

entries.title: Joshua 21:32
segments: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee and its open lands [as] a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Hammoth-dor and its open lands, and Kartah and its open lands; three cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:33
segments: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families [were] thirteen cities and their open lands.

entries.title: Joshua 21:34
segments: And to the families of the sons of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam and its open lands, and Kartah and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:35
segments: Dimnah and its open lands, Nahalal and its open lands; four cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:36
segments: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer and its open lands, and Jahazah and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:37
segments: Kedemoth and its open lands, and Mephaath and its open lands; four cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:38
segments: And out of tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead and its open lands [as] a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Mahanaim and its open lands,

entries.title: Joshua 21:39
segments: Heshbon and its open lands, Jazer and its open lands; four cities in all.

entries.title: Joshua 21:40
segments: All the cities for the sons of Merari by their families which were left of the families of the Levites, were [by] their lot twelve cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:41
segments: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the sons of Israel [were] forty-eight cities and their open lands.

entries.title: Joshua 21:42
segments: These cities [were] each one with their open lands around them. So it was to all these cities.

entries.title: Joshua 21:43
segments: And the LORD gave to Israel all the land which He swore to give to their fathers. And they possessed it, and lived in it.

entries.title: Joshua 21:44
segments: And Jehovah gave them rest round about, according to all that He swore to their fathers. And not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Jehovah delivered all their enemies into their hand.

entries.title: Joshua 21:45
segments: Not a word failed from any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
